# Cannot compute: CN code not in the factor table

I cannot calculate the embedded emissions for this consignment under the supplied ruleset.

## Inputs Check

| Required input | Provided in scenario | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | CN 7202 11 (ferro-manganese, > 2% carbon) | ❌ **Not in the table** |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | China | ❌ **Cannot be validated**, because the good is not in the table |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 500 t | ✅ Provided |

## Missing Input

- **A default SEE value (tCO2e/t) for CN 7202 11, ferro-manganese with > 2% carbon, produced in China.** The table covers only CN 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. No row exists for any CN 7202 code, for any country.

## Why No Proxy Was Used

I did not substitute a factor from another row, such as CN 7201 pig iron for China at 1.66 tCO2e/t. The ruleset selects the SEE jointly by CN code and country. It also says not to estimate when a required input is missing from the table. Ferro-alloys are a different product from pig iron, and any proxy figure would not be compliant with these rules.

## To Proceed

Provide an updated factor table that includes a default SEE for **CN 7202 11 × China**. The calculation is then: SEE × 500 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
